[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Drev Prilarca''' was a member of the [[New Republic Security Force]]'s [[Arms Interdiction Task Force]]. Prilarca requested a retired [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Major/Legends|major]] named [[Shepprd Barron]] to obtain information related to the [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] "[[Gundark (arms dealer)|Gundark]]" from the [[CorSec criminal database]].<ref name="GFTPG" />
